item.name: Auth
item.description:
Authentication and session endpoints for SafePath.

Base URL: `{{authUrl}}` (`{{baseUrl}}{{apiPrefix}}/auth`).

Demo sequence:
1. Register → copy the OTP into `registrationOtp` → Verify Email
2. Login - Demo User → Get Me → Refresh Token → Logout
3. Forgot Password → copy OTP into `forgotPasswordOtp` → Reset Password
4. Request Account Restore → copy OTP into `restoreOtp` → Verify Account Restore

The seeded accounts require `SEED_ON_START=true`:
- user@safepath.local / User@12345
- admin@safepath.local / Admin@12345

item.name: Dashboard
item.description:
Role-aware dashboard overview. The response changes based on the authenticated account role: USER, ADMIN, or SUPER_ADMIN.

Base URL: `{{dashboardUrl}}` (`{{baseUrl}}{{apiPrefix}}/dashboard`).

item.name: User
item.description:
